# The Ceiling Gap

Ceiling accent spots serve feature walls and end caps. On middle shelves and packed gondolas, the beam from above falls short of the merchandise. The shelf-level layer decides where the goods actually sit, and the spec has to be checked from the aisle, not from the plan.

## The shelf-level layer

Ceiling accent spots serve feature walls and end caps well enough. On middle shelves and packed gondolas, the beam from above often falls short of the merchandise. The light that lands on the goods is the shelf-level layer, so the spec has to be checked where the merchandise actually sits, from the aisle, not from the plan.
